description: Fetch the logged-in user's personalized Pinterest home feed — the masonry stream of Pins shown at https://www.pinterest.com/. Returns each Pin's id, title, description, full-resolution image URL (or HLS playlist URL for video Pins), outbound source link, creator (username + display name), and Pin page URL. Scrolls to load more up to the limit. Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Pins to return (1-100, default 20). The feed lazy-loads on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the feed is exhausted (then returns fewer with partial=true).
